title: SCTIMST Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for Project Assistant Posts
description: The Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancy for 01 Project Assistant Post. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for this post before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, and Mechanical Engineering can apply for the SCTIMST Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply online.
